title: Shubh Yatra, Swachh Yatra at Kalol Bus Station
excerpt: A public cleanliness campaign featuring street theatre, wall art, and community dialogue to promote civic hygiene at Kalol Bus Station.
coverImageAlt: Public cleanliness awareness campaign at Kalol Bus Station
bodyMarkdown:
## Campaign purpose

Megh Foundation organized the **Shubh Yatra, Swachh Yatra** campaign at Kalol Bus Station to support cleaner public spaces and stronger civic participation.

## Activity highlights

- Nukkad natak (street play) on public hygiene behavior
- Wall painting with messages on cleanliness and civic duty
- Direct interaction sessions with commuters and local residents
- Public feedback collection for future campaign planning

## Community value

The campaign encouraged people to view cleanliness as a shared responsibility rather than a one-time drive.

## Forward path

By combining culture, communication, and civic action, Megh Foundation continues to build practical awareness campaigns that are easy for communities to adopt.
